subject: Salem Street Neighborhood Corridor Rezoning
overview: The City Council approved a zoning map change for the Salem Street corridor and endorsed a joint agreement with the Mayor to restructure the city's broader zoning project. The Council also accepted a major forestry donation, approved library union wage increases, and greenlit CPA funding for church accessibility upgrades.

items.title: Meeting Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: The Council approved the meeting records of November 18, 2025, and accepted committee reports regarding police department ICE activity and a real estate development presentation.

items.title: Salem Street Corridor Rezoning Map Change
items.summary: Following the approval of a B-paper endorsing a joint update process with the Mayor, the Council adopted a zoning map amendment changing the designation of parcels in the Salem Street and Park Street node from MX2 to MX1.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust Action Plan and Guidelines
items.summary: The Affordable Housing Trust presented its Action Plan and Guidelines for 2025 to 2030, which the Council voted to receive and place on file after extensive discussion.

items.title: Library Union Wage Adjustment
items.summary: The Council ordained proposed wage adjustments for the library union, establishing annual salary increases of 3%, 2.5%, and 2.25% through fiscal year 2028.

items.title: Trees Medford Donation
items.summary: The Council accepted a $25,000 cash donation from Trees Medford to fund public tree plantings.

items.title: Shiloh Baptist Church Appropriation
items.summary: The Council approved a $55,000 appropriation from the CPA Historic Preservation Reserve for ongoing ADA accessibility improvements at the Shiloh Baptist Church.
